question: Recently, e-books have become commonplace, and the number of web comics has increased, but I feel like One Piece has a lot of panels that span across large pages, in addition to large double-page spreads. Are you thinking of this as a paper book?
answer: Recently, they've started digital versions of Jump. Everyone is free to read it however they want, but I'm thinking, in the case of the Jump magazine and comics, they're meant to be horizontally on devices like a PC or iPad. I guess that's what I mean. For example, when I want to draw an amazing spread, I might intentionally make the the left corner of the previous page smaller, aiming for a visual effect that makes the large panel appear even larger when the page is turned. The size of panels is also a part of artistic expression. So, I can only say sorry to those who read it on a smartphone's vertical screen, lol.
name: Hamachi
